text:
emily.marketing: Quick sync — final checklist for Wed webinar + post-launch benchmark narrative. Need a short runbook for keywords, schema JSON-LD, internal linking plan, and redirect tidy. Can @oliver_seo and @raj.kapoor review? doc: https://tiny.redwood/webinar-seo

oliver_seo: On it. I'll run a keyword gap report this morning. Which landing URL do we lock to first: /learn/benchmark-narrative or /product/benchmarks?

emily.marketing: Lock /learn/benchmark-narrative as canonical for the narrative post. /product/benchmarks is secondary and will link back. Core seed keywords I want on the page: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference latency benchmark", "cost per token benchmark" — oliver please expand with 5 long-tail targets.

raj.kapoor: I'll produce JSON-LD for Event + VideoObject + FAQ. Also propose a small HowTo snippet for the benchmark quickstart. Need final canonical + utm values to bake into schema.

marta_ops: canonical = https://redwood.com/learn/benchmark-narrative. UTM for emails/ads = ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch. I'll coordinate with release.

oliver_seo: Adding longtails: "inference cost optimization for startups", "dedicated inference throughput benchmarks", "GPU quantization latency comparisons", "LLM serving cost per request", "batching vs latency tradeoff benchmarks". I'll drop anchors suggestions in the doc: link to /docs/dedicated, /docs/private-deploy, /pricing. Keep anchor text descriptive, avoid 'learn more' on all.

jordan: heads up — redirect scan found a collision: /benchmarks currently 301 -> /learn/benchmark-narrative but there's an old campaign redirect /benchmarks-2024 still active pointing to the legacy blog. We should consolidate before promo.

ops-bot: redirect-check: /benchmarks-2024 -> 410 (exists). Recommendation: create 301 -> /learn/benchmark-narrative. Run: `redirect-scan --prefix /benchmarks` and `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-2024 /learn/benchmark-narrative`

emily.marketing: Good catch. raj + oliver aim to freeze keywords & schema by EOD. marta, can you schedule redirect edits with eng-release? jordan, please open the release ticket for a small redirect + canonical update.

jordan: Filed RED-3421 for redirect consolidation + canonical swap, assigned to eng-release. ETA Tue 9am PT for cutover, rollback included.

marta_ops: Scheduling redirect cutover Tue 10am PT and will announce in #release-war-room. QA checklist: run Screaming Frog crawl, validate JSON-LD (https://validator.schema.org), check canonical tag, and smoke test hreflang (if any).

oliver_seo: One more SEO tweak: add structured data for HowTo for the benchmark quickstart — helps SERP rich result for 'how to run inference benchmarks'. Also include `mainEntityOfPage` pointing to canonical.

emily.marketing: Perfect. If no blockers we'll ship the reminder emails + CTAs on Wed. Quick action items: oliver finalize KW list, raj deliver JSON-LD snippets, marta coordinate redirects + QA, jordan run release. Ping here when each is done. :rocket:
